Terms & Conditions

Updated: 5/23/24

Terms and Conditions

By opting into our services, you agree to receive recurring automated marketing and informational communications from AAA Advantage Home Care. These communications may include text messages, emails, and phone calls. Automated messages may be sent using an automatic telephone dialing system to the mobile telephone number and email address you provided when signing up or any other number or email address that you designate.

Message and Email Frequency

Message and email frequency varies, and additional communications may be sent periodically based on your interaction with AAA Advantage Home Care. AAA Advantage Home Care reserves the right to alter the frequency of messages and emails sent at any time to increase or decrease the total number of sent communications. AAA Advantage Home Care also reserves the right to change the short code, phone number, or email address from which messages and emails are sent.

Message, Data, and Email Rates

Message, data, and email rates may apply. If you have any questions about your text plan, data plan, or email plan, it is best to contact your wireless provider or email service provider. Your wireless provider and email service provider are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages or emails.

Consent

Your consent to receive marketing messages, emails, and phone calls is not a condition of purchase.

Carriers and Email Providers

Carriers and email providers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages or emails.

Cancellation

You can cancel any time by texting “STOP” for SMS messages or clicking the “unsubscribe” link in any email. After you send the SMS message “STOP” or click the “unsubscribe” link, we will send you a message or email to confirm that you have been unsubscribed and no more messages or emails will be sent. If you would like to receive messages or emails from AAA Advantage Home Care again, just sign up as you did the first time and AAA Advantage Home Care will start sending messages and emails to you again.

Info

Text “HELP” at any time and we will respond with instructions on how to unsubscribe. For support regarding our services, email us at daniel (at) aaaadvantagehomecare.com.

Transfer of Number or Email Address

You agree that before changing your mobile number, transferring your mobile number to another individual, or changing your email address, you will either reply “STOP” from the original number or email address or notify us of your old number or email address at daniel@aaaadvantagehomecare.com. The duty to inform us based on the above events is a condition of using this service to receive messages and emails.

Privacy

If you have any questions about your data or our privacy practices, please visit our Privacy Policy.

Messaging and Email Terms Changes

We reserve the right to change or terminate our messaging and email program at any time. We also reserve the right to update these Terms and Conditions at any time. Such changes will be effective immediately upon posting. Your continued enrollment following such changes shall constitute your acceptance of such changes.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - AAA Advantage Home Care
privacy.html:
Privacy Policy

AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. Privacy Policy

Last Updated: 5/23/24

AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. (“Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal information is collected, used, and disclosed by AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. This Privacy Policy applies to our website and its associated subdomains (collectively, our “Service”). By accessing or using our Service, you signify that you have read, understood, and agree to our collection, storage, use, and disclosure of your personal information as described in this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service.

Information We Collect

Information You Provide

  • Contact Information: We collect personally identifiable information such as your name, email address, and phone number when you register for our service, sign up for our newsletter, or otherwise communicate with us.
  • Health-Related Information: If you use our services, we may collect health-related information that you choose to provide to us.

Automatically Collected Information

  • Log and Usage Data: We collect information related to your access and use of our Service, including the type of browser you use, access times, pages viewed, and your IP address.
  • Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Service and hold certain information.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to operate, maintain, and provide to you the features and functionality of the Service, including:

  • Providing and delivering the services you request, processing transactions, and sending you related information, including confirmations and reminders.
  • Sending you technical notices, updates, security alerts, support messages, and administrative messages.
  • Responding to your comments, questions, and requests and providing customer service.
  • Communicating with you about products, services, offers, promotions, and events offered by AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. and others, and provide news and information we think will be of interest to you.

Monitoring and analyzing trends, usage, and activities in connection with our Service.

  • Email Campaigns: Sending you promotional emails and newsletters about our products, services, offers, promotions, and events.
  • SMS Drip Campaigns: Sending you a series of automated SMS messages related to our products, services, promotions, and updates.
  • Phone Calls: Contacting you via phone calls to discuss our services, respond to your inquiries, and provide customer support.

How We Share Your Information

Vendors and Service Providers

We may share your information with third-party vendors and service providers that help us with various aspects of our business, such as website management, email delivery, SMS services, and marketing.

Compliance with Laws

We may disclose your information where required to do so by law or in response to a subpoena or court order.

Business Transfers

In the event AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. goes through a business transition, such as a merger, acquisition by another company, or sale of all or a portion of its assets, your personal information may be among the assets transferred.

Your Choices

Cookies

You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when cookies are being sent. If you disable or refuse cookies, please note that some parts of this site may then be inaccessible or may not function properly.

Email Communications

You can opt-out of receiving promotional emails from AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. by following the instructions in those emails. If you opt-out, we may still send you non-promotional emails, such as those about your account or our ongoing business relations.

SMS Communications

You may opt-out of receiving SMS messages from us at any time by replying “STOP” to any message you receive. After you opt-out, we will send you one final message to confirm that you have been unsubscribed. Please note that opting out of SMS messages may impact your use of our services.

Phone Calls

If you do not wish to receive phone calls from us, you can request to be added to our do-not-call list by contacting us directly.

Security

We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.

Children’s Privacy

Our Service is not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13. If we learn we have collected or received personal information from a child under 13, we will delete that information.

SMS Terms & Conditions

By providing your mobile phone number, you consent to receive SMS messages from AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. related to our products, services, promotions, and updates.

Message frequency may vary. Standard message and data rates may apply.

You may opt out of receiving SMS messages at any time by replying with “STOP” to any SMS message you receive from us. After opting out, you will receive a confirmation message, and we will cease sending SMS messages to your number.

If you need assistance or have questions about our SMS service, reply with “HELP” to any SMS message you receive, or contact our customer support team at daniel@aaaadvantagehomecare.com.

Your phone number will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes.

All the above categories exclude text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the “Last Updated” date at the top of this Privacy Policy.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: daniel@aaaadvantagehomecare.com

AAA Advantage Home Care Inc. All rights reserved.

about.html:
About Us

Whether you are looking for a compassionate caregiver or want to become one, contact us to know more about our services.

About AAA Advantage Home Care Agency

AAA Advantage Home Care Agency provides comprehensive home care and caregiver services in Michigan, Missouri, and South Dakota. We are dedicated to helping older adults, individuals with disabilities, and those who need assistance with daily activities live safely, comfortably, and independently at home.

Our services include adult companion care, attendant care, personal care, homemaking, respite care, and structured family caregiving. Whether older adults need assistance with personal care and daily activities, companionship, mobility, meals, or household tasks, we provide dependable support based on each individual’s needs, preferences, routines, and goals.

We also recognize the essential role family caregivers play, providing guidance, resources, and support to help families navigate their caregiving responsibilities. Moreover, family caregivers can receive compensation based on their eligibility and applicable programs.

AAA Home Care believes caregiving is about more than completing daily tasks. It is about building trust, supporting independence, strengthening families, and helping people live with confidence in the comfort of home.

Our mission is to provide compassionate, reliable support that empowers individuals and the families who care for them, while maintaining their dignity and quality of life. We serve families across Michigan, Missouri, and South Dakota, making quality home care more accessible and meaningful for both the caregiver and the person receiving care.
